title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: goodwill waiver limits by category
content:
## What this card covers
This card lists, for each acceptance category of the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the three figures that bound a goodwill waiver by the desk: the largest single fee row the desk may waive, the number of goodwill dangerous-goods waivers per customer in a trailing 365 days, and the number of calendar days after a fee was booked within which a waiver may be requested.

## Limits by category
| Category | Largest fee row the desk may waive (USD) | Goodwill waivers per customer per trailing 365 days | Request window after the fee was booked (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 0.00 | 0 | 30 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 100.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 150.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 200.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 200.00 | 1 | 30 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 0.00 | 0 | 15 |

## Distinguishing the categories
- AHL DG Limited Quantity and AHL DG Special Approval show 0.00 for the waiver authority and 0 for the number of waivers.
- AHL DG Special Approval has the shorter request window, 15 calendar days; every other category has 30.
- The authority is stated per fee row; the waiver count is stated per customer across the trailing 365 days.

## Basis Q&A
- *What is the desk's waiver authority under AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives?* 150.00 USD per fee row.
- *How many goodwill waivers does AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers allow in a trailing 365 days?* 1.
